Injectable I/O layer.\n//!\n//! All repository disk access goes through the [`Vfs`] trait:\n//! - [`RealVfs`] performs ordinary filesystem operations (with fsync and\n//!   atomic temp-file renames for the durability/sync boundaries);\n//! - [`MemVfs`] is an in-memory filesystem used by tests;\n//! - [`FaultyVfs`] wraps either implementation and injects I/O errors or byte\n//!   corruption on a selected call number, so crash/torn-write recovery can be\n//!   exercised without real disks.\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read as _, Seek as _, SeekFrom, Write as _};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool>;\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// Overwrite atomically: write `tmp`, fsync, rename over target, fsync dir.\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn len(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<u64>;\n    fn read_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize>;\n    /// Create if missing (zero-filled) and overwrite bytes at `offset`.\n    fn write_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn truncate(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn sync(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Real filesystem.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealVfs;\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for RealVfs {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nfn sync_dir(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n    let dir = path.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new(\".\"));\n    let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).open(dir)?;\n    f.sync_all()\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {\n        Ok(path.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        std::fs::read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut tmp = PathBuf::from(path);\n        let file_name = tmp\n            .file_name()\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"bad path\"))?\n            .to_owned();\n        tmp.set_file_name(format!(\".{}.tmp-{}\", file_name.to_string_lossy(), std::process::id()));\n        {\n            let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                .write(true)\n                .create(true)\n                .truncate(true)\n                .open(&tmp)?;\n            f.write_all(data)?;\n            f.sync_all()?;\n        }\n        std::fs::rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        sync_dir(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::remove_file(path)\n    }\n\n    fn len(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        Ok(std::fs::metadata(path)?.len())\n    }\n\n    fn read_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).open(path)?;\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset))?;\n        f.read(buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset))?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn truncate(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(path)?;\n        f.set_len(len)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// In-memory filesystem.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[derive(Default)]\nstruct MemInner {\n    files: BTreeMap<PathBuf, Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Default)]\npub struct MemVfs {\n    inner: Arc<Mutex<MemInner>>,\n}\n\nimpl MemVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    /// Test helper: raw snapshot of a file (or an empty buffer if absent).\n    pub fn snapshot(&self, path: &Path) -> Vec<u8> {\n        self.inner\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap()\n            .files\n            .get(path)\n            .cloned()\n            .unwrap_or_default()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for MemVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {\n        Ok(self.inner.lock().unwrap().files.contains_key(path))\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        match self.inner.lock().unwrap().files.get(path) {\n            Some(d) => Ok(d.clone()),\n            None => Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"memfs: no such file\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        g.files.insert(path.to_path_buf(), data.to_vec());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        match g.files.remove(path) {\n            Some(_) => Ok(()),\n            None => Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"memfs: no such file\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn len(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        match self.inner.lock().unwrap().files.get(path) {\n            Some(d) => Ok(d.len() as u64),\n            None => Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"memfs: no such file\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn read_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        match g.files.get(path) {\n            Some(d) => {\n                let off = offset as usize;\n                if off >= d.len() {\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n                let n = buf.len().min(d.len() - off);\n                buf[..n].copy_from_slice(&d[off..off + n]);\n                Ok(n)\n            }\n            None => Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"memfs: no such file\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn write_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        let entry = g.files.entry(path.to_path_buf()).or_default();\n        let end = offset as usize + data.len();\n        if end > entry.len() {\n            entry.resize(end, 0);\n        }\n        entry[offset as usize..end].copy_from_slice(data);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn truncate(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        match g.files.get_mut(path) {\n            Some(d) => {\n                d.resize(len as usize, 0);\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            None => Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"memfs: no such file\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self, _path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Fault-injecting wrapper.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Op {\n    Exists,\n    Read,\n    WriteAtomic,\n    Remove,\n    Len,\n    ReadAt,\n    WriteAt,\n    Truncate,\n    Sync,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nenum Effect {\n    /// Fail the nth matching call with an io::Error.\n    Fail(u64),\n    /// Flip the first byte written by the nth matching call (torn write).\n    Corrupt(u64),\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\nstruct Rule {\n    op: Op,\n    path_contains: Option<String>,\n    effect: Effect,\n    fired: bool,\n}\n\n/// Wraps a [`Vfs`]; each rule fires at most once. Typical test use:\n/// `FaultyVfs::new(inner).fail_on(Op::WriteAtomic, Some(\"manifest\"), 3)`.\npub struct FaultyVfs<V: Vfs> {\n    inner: V,\n    rules: Mutex<Vec<Rule>>,\n    counters: Mutex<BTreeMap<(Op, String), u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl<V: Vfs> FaultyVfs<V> {\n    pub fn new(inner: V) -> Self {\n        FaultyVfs {\n            inner,\n            rules: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),\n            counters: Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn fail_on(self, op: Op, path_contains: Option<&str>, nth: u64) -> Self {\n        self.rules.lock().unwrap().push(Rule {\n            op,\n            path_contains: path_contains.map(str::to_string),\n            effect: Effect::Fail(nth),\n            fired: false,\n        });\n        self\n    }\n\n    pub fn corrupt_on(self, op: Op, path_contains: Option<&str>, nth: u64) -> Self {\n        self.rules.lock().unwrap().push(Rule {\n            op,\n            path_contains: path_contains.map(str::to_string),\n            effect: Effect::Corrupt(nth),\n            fired: false,\n        });\n\n    }\n\n    /// True once every rule has triggered.\n    pub fn all_fired(&self) -> bool {\n        self.rules.lock().unwrap().iter().all(|r| r.fired)\n    }\n\n    fn gate(&self, op: Op, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let key = (op, path.to_string_lossy().into_owned());\n        let count = {\n            let mut counters = self.counters.lock().unwrap();\n            let c = counters.entry(key).or_insert(0);\n            *c += 1;\n            *c\n        };\n        let mut rules = self.rules.lock().unwrap();\n        for r in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if r.fired || r.op != op {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if let Some(needle) = &r.path_contains {\n                if !path.to_string_lossy().contains(needle) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n            }\n            let nth = match r.effect {\n                Effect::Fail(n) | Effect::Corrupt(n) => n,\n            };\n            if nth == count {\n                r.fired = true;\n                if matches!(r.effect, Effect::Fail(_)) {\n                    return Err(io::Error::new(\n                        io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                        format!(\"injected {op:?} fault on {}\", path.display()),\n                    ));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// For Corrupt rules: optionally mutate data right before a write.\n    fn corrupt(&self, op: Op, path: &Path, data: &mut [u8]) {\n        let key = (op, path.to_string_lossy().into_owned());\n        // Corruption shares the counting with the gate.\n        let count = *self\n            .counters\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap()\n            .entry(key)\n            .or_insert(0)\n            // gate() already incremented, so read current.\n    }\n\n    fn should_corrupt(&self, op: Op, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> bool {\n        if data.is_empty() {\n            return false;\n        }\n        let count = *self\n            .counters\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap()\n            .get(&(op, path.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))\n            .unwrap_or(&0);\n        let rules = self.rules.lock().unwrap();\n        rules.iter().any(|r| {\n            !r.fired\n                && r.op == op\n                && matches!(r.effect, Effect::Corrupt(n) if n == count)\n                && r\n                    .path_contains\n                    .as_ref()\n                    .map(|needle| path.to_string_lossy().contains(needle))\n                    .unwrap_or(true)\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<V: Vfs> Vfs for FaultyVfs<V> {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {\n        self.gate(Op::Exists, path)?;\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.gate(Op::Read, path)?;\n        self.inner.read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::WriteAtomic, path)?;\n        let mut buf;\n        let data = if self.should_corrupt(Op::WriteAtomic, path, data) {\n            buf = data.to_vec();\n            buf[0] ^= 0xff;\n            &buf[..]\n        } else {\n            data\n        };\n        self.inner.write_atomic(path, data)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::Remove, path)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n\n    fn len(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.gate(Op::Len, path)?;\n        self.inner.len(path)\n    }\n\n    fn read_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.gate(Op::ReadAt, path)?;\n        self.inner.read_at(path, offset, buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::WriteAt, path)?;\n        let mut owned;\n        let data = if self.should_corrupt(Op::WriteAt, path, data) {\n            owned = data.to_vec();\n            owned[0] ^= 0xff;\n            &owned[..]\n        } else {\n            data\n        };\n        self.inner.write_at(path, offset, data)\n    }\n\n    fn truncate(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::Truncate, path)?;\n        self.inner.truncate(path, len)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.gate(Op::Sync, path)?;\n        self.inner.sync(path)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn memfs_write_read_and_holes() {\n        let fs = MemVfs::new();\n        fs.write_at(Path::new(\"f\"), 0, b\"hello\").unwrap();\n        fs.write_at(Path::new(\"f\"), 10, b\"xyz\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(fs.len(Path::new(\"f\")).unwrap(), 13);\n        let d = fs.read(Path::new(\"f\")).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(&d[..5], b\"hello\");\n        assert_eq!(&d[5..10], &[0; 5]);\n        assert_eq!(&d[10..], b\"xyz\");\n        fs.truncate(Path::new(\"f\"), 6).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(fs.len(Path::new(\"f\")).unwrap(), 6);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn faulty_fires_once_then_passes() {\n        let fs = FaultyVfs::new(MemVfs::new()).fail_on(Op::WriteAt, Some(\"f\"), 2);\n        fs.write_at(Path::new(\"f\"), 0, b\"a\").unwrap();\n        assert!(fs.write_at(Path::new(\"f\"), 0, b\"b\").is_err());\n        fs.write_at(Path::new(\"f\"), 0, b\"c\").unwrap();\n        assert!(fs.all_fired());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn corrupt_flips_byte() {\n        let fs = FaultyVfs::new(MemVfs::new()).corrupt_on(Op::WriteAt, Some(\"f\"), 1);\n        fs.write_at(Path::new(\"f\"), 0, b\"abc\").unwrap();\n        let d = fs.read(Path::new(\"f\")).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(&d, b\"Xbc\");\n All repository disk access goes through the [`Vfs`] trait:\n//! - [`RealVfs`] performs ordinary filesystem operations (with fsync and\n//!   atomic temp-file renames for the durability/sync crash/torn-write recovery can be\n//!   exercised without real disks.\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read as _, Seek as _, SeekFrom, Write as _};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool>;\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    /// Overwrite atomically: write `tmp`, fsync, rename over target, fsync dir.\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn len(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<u64>;\n    fn read_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize>;\n    /// Create if missing (zero-filled) and overwrite bytes at `offset`.\n    fn write_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn truncate(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn sync(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Real filesystem.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealVfs;\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for RealVfs {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nfn sync_dir(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n    let dir = path.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new(\".\"));\n    let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).open(dir)?;\n    f.sync_all()\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {\n        Ok(path.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        std::fs::read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn write_atomic(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut tmp = PathBuf::from(path);\n        let file_name = tmp\n            .file_name()\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"bad path\"))?\n            .to_owned();\n        tmp.set_file_name(format!(\n            \".{}.tmp-{}\",\n            file_name.to_string_lossy(),\n            std::process::id()\n        ));\n        {\n            let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                .write(true)\n                .create(true)\n                .truncate(true)\n                .open(&tmp)?;\n            f.write_all(data)?;\n            f.sync_all()?;\n        }\n        std::fs::rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        sync_dir(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::remove_file(path)\n    }\n\n let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).open(path)?;\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset))?;\n        f.read(buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write_at(&self, path: &Path, offset: u64, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset))?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn truncate(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(path)?;\n        f.set_len(len)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// In-memory filesystem.\n// {"parentUuid":"aa505eaf-f247-413f-b99e-f7eb2fda505a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_p7zchblo0263lholwwnxcvg1","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/a/src/store.rs","content":"//! File-backed chunked block store with per-level Merkle node files.\n//!\n//! ## On-disk format (all integers big-endian)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <repo>/\n//!   manifest           64 bytes (see below)\n//!   journal            present only while a write transaction is committed\n//!   data.bin           raw file bytes\n//!   level-0.bin        n  * 32 bytes — leaf hashes\n//!   level-1.bin        ⌈n/2⌉ * 32 bytes\n//!   ...                one file per tree level\n//! ```\n//!\n//! ### manifest (64 bytes)\n//! | offset | size | field       |\n//! |--------|------|-------------|\n//! | 0      | 16   | magic `MS-MANIFEST-V1\\0\\0` |\n//! | 16     | 8    | block_size (u64) |\n//! | 24     | 8    | data_len (u64) |\n//! | 32     | 8    | n (u64, leaf/block count) |\n//! | 40     | 24   | reserved, zero |\n//!\n//! A manifest is published only via temp-file + fsync + rename + dir fsync, so\n//! a 64-byte file is either the previous or the new manifest, never torn.\n//!\n//! ### journal\n//! | magic `MS-JOURNAL-V1\\0\\0\\0\\0` (16) |\n//! repeated entries:\n//! | op:u8 = 1 put / 2 reset | index:u64 | len:u64 | data(len) |\n//! For `reset` there is one leading entry carrying the whole new payload and\n//! n = ceil(len/block_size). `put` entries may append or overwrite one block.\n//!\n//! ## Sync boundary per mutating request\n//! 1. Journal written atomically (temp+fsync+rename+dir fsync).\n//! 2. `data.bin` patched (pwrite + fsync) — truncate when needed.\n//! 3. Affected Merkle levels patched incrementally (pwrite + fsync each).\n//! 4. New manifest published atomically; journal deleted; directory fsynced.\n//!\n//! Crash between 1 and 4 is repaired on next open by replaying the journal\n//! against `data.bin` and fully rebuilding every level file — always safe\n//! whether or not some level bytes had already been patched.\n\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse crate::merkle::{\n    self, build_levels, empty_root, internal_hash, leaf_hash, Hash32, RangeProof,\n};\nuse crate::vfs::Vfs;\n\nconst MANIFEST_MAGIC: &[u8; 16] = b\"MS-MANIFEST-V1\\0\\0\";\nconst JOURNAL_MAGIC: &[u8; 16] = b\"MS-JOURNAL-V1\\0\\0\\0\\0\";\nconst MANIFEST_LEN: usize = 64;\n\nconst OP_PUT: u8 = 1;\nconst OP_RESET: u8 = 2;\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    Io(io::Error),\n    Corrupt(String),\n    InvalidInput(String),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"io error: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::Corrupt(s) => write!(f, \"repository corrupt: {s}\"),\n            StoreError::InvalidInput(s) => write!(f, \"invalid request: {s}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\n\nimpl From<io::Error> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\ntype Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, StoreError>;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub block_size: u64,\n    pub data_len: u64,\n    pub n: u64,\n}\n\npub struct Store<V: Vfs> {\n    vfs: V,\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    block_size: u64,\n    data_len: u64,\n    n: u64,\n}\n\nfn data_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"data.bin\")\n}\nfn level_path(dir: &Path, level: usize) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(format!(\"level-{level}.bin\"))\n}\nfn manifest_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"manifest\")\n}\nfn journal_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"journal\")\n}\n\nfn encode_manifest(m: &Manifest) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut buf = vec![0u8; MANIFEST_LEN];\n    buf[0..16].copy_from_slice(MANIFEST_MAGIC);\n    buf[16..24].copy_from_slice(&m.block_size.to_be_bytes());\n    buf[24..32].copy_from_slice(&m.data_len.to_be_bytes());\n    buf[32..40].copy_from_slice(&m.n.to_be_bytes());\n    buf\n}\n\nfn decode_manifest(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Manifest> {\n    if buf.len() != MANIFEST_LEN || &buf[0..16] != MANIFEST_MAGIC {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"bad manifest magic/length\".into()));\n    }\n    let rd = |o: usize| -> u64 {\n        let mut b = [0u8; 8];\n        b.copy_from_slice(&buf[o..o + 8]);\n        u64::from_be_bytes(b)\n    };\n    let block_size = rd(16);\n    let data_len = rd(24);\n    let n = rd(32);\n    if block_size == 0 {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"block_size is zero\".into()));\n    }\n    if !buf[40..].iter().all(|&b| b == 0) {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"reserved manifest bytes non-zero\".into()));\n    }\n    let want_n = if data_len == 0 { 0 } else { (data_len - 1) / block_size + 1 };\n    if want_n != n {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(format!(\n            \"manifest n={n} inconsistent with data_len={data_len}, block_size={block_size}\"\n        )));\n    }\n    Ok(Manifest { block_size, data_len, n })\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct JournalEntry {\n    op: u8,\n    index: u64,\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn encode_journal(entries: &[JournalEntry]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::new();\n    buf.extend_from_slice(JOURNAL_MAGIC);\n    for e in entries {\n        buf.push(e.op);\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&e.index.to_be_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&(e.data.len() as u64).to_be_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&e.data);\n    }\n    buf\n}\n\nfn decode_journal(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<JournalEntry>> {\n    if buf.len() < 16 || &buf[0..16] != JOURNAL_MAGIC {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"bad journal magic\".into()));\n    }\n    let mut pos = 16;\n    let mut entries = Vec::new();\n    while pos < buf.len() {\n        if pos + 17 > buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"truncated journal header\".into()));\n        }\n        let op = buf[pos];\n        if op != OP_PUT && op != OP_RESET {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(format!(\"unknown journal op {op}\")));\n        }\n        let rd = |o: usize| -> u64 {\n            let mut b = [0u8; 8];\n            b.copy_from_slice(&buf[o..o + 8]);\n            u64::from_be_bytes(b)\n        };\n        let index = rd(pos + 1);\n        let len = rd(pos + 9) as usize;\n        pos += 17;\n        if pos + len > buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"truncated journal payload\".into()));\n        }\n        entries.push(JournalEntry {\n            op,\n            index,\n            data: buf[pos..pos + len].to_vec(),\n        });\n        pos += len;\n    }\n    Ok(entries)\n}\n\n// Level-file helpers ---------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn read_hash(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &Path, idx: u64) -> io::Result<Hash32> {\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 32];\n    let n = vfs.read_at(path, idx * 32, &mut buf)?;\n    if n != 32 {\n        return Err(io::Error::new(\n            io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n            \"level file short read\",\n        ));\n    }\n    Ok(buf)\n}\n\nfn write_hash(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &Path, idx: u64, h: &Hash32) -> io::Result<()> {\n    vfs.write_at(path, idx * 32, h)\n}\n\nimpl<V: Vfs> Store<V> {\n    // Open / create ----------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Open an existing repository, replaying an outstanding journal if any.\n    pub fn open(vfs: V, dir: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?; // harmless for MemVfs? — see below.\n        let mp = manifest_path(dir);\n        if !vfs.exists(&mp)? {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\n                \"no manifest in directory (use create first)\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let raw = vfs.read(&mp)?;\n        let m = decode_manifest(&raw)?;\n\n        let mut store = Store {\n            vfs,\n            dir: dir.to_path_buf(),\n            block_size: m.block_size,\n            data_len: m.data_len,\n            n: m.n,\n        };\n\n        let jp = journal_path(dir);\n        if store.vfs.exists(&jp)? {\n            store.recover()?;\n        }\n        Ok(store)\n    }\n\n    /// Create a fresh empty repository. Fails if one already exists.\n    pub fn create(vfs: V, dir: &Path, block_size: u64) -> Result<Self> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;\n        if block_size == 0 {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\"block_size must be > 0\".into()));\n        }\n        let mp = manifest_path(dir);\n        if vfs.exists(&mp)? {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\n                \"repository already exists\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let mut store = Store {\n            vfs,\n            dir: dir.to_path_buf(),\n            block_size,\n            data_len: 0,\n            n: 0,\n        };\n        store.vfs.write_atomic(&data_path(dir), &[])?;\n        store.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(store)\n    }\n\n    // Accessors --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    pub fn block_size(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.block_size\n    }\n    pub fn data_len(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.data_len\n    }\n    pub fn block_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.n\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> Result<Hash32> {\n        if self.n == 0 {\n            return Ok(empty_root());\n        }\n        let height = self.height();\n        read_hash(&self.vfs, &level_path(&self.dir, height), 0).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    /// Height = level index of the root.\n    fn height(&self) -> usize {\n        let n = self.n;\n        if n <= 1 {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        (63 - (n - 1).leading_zeros()) as usize + 1\n    }\n\n    pub fn read_block(&self, index: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        if index >= self.n {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block index {index} out of range (n={})\",\n                self.n\n            )));\n        }\n        let start = index * self.block_size;\n        let end = ((start + self.block_size).min(self.data_len)) as usize;\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; end - start as usize];\n        let got = self.vfs.read_at(&data_path(&self.dir), start, &mut buf)?;\n        if got != buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"data.bin short read\".into()));\n        }\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    pub fn read_data(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.vfs.read(&data_path(&self.dir)).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    pub fn manifest(&self) -> Manifest {\n        Manifest {\n            block_size: self.block_size,\n            data_len: self.data_len,\n            n: self.n,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn node(&self, level: usize, index: u64) -> Result<Hash32> {\n        read_hash(&self.vfs, &level_path(&self.dir, level), index).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    /// Build a range proof for blocks `[start,end)`, reading only the proof\n    /// nodes from disk — never the full data file.\n    pub fn prove_range(&self, start: u64, end: u64) -> Result<RangeProof> {\n        merkle::prove(self.n as usize, start as usize, end as usize, |lvl, idx| {\n            self.node(lvl, idx as u64).expect(\"node read\")\n        })\n        .map_err(|e| StoreError::InvalidInput(e.to_string()))\n    }\n\n    // Mutations --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Put (insert/overwrite) one block.\n    ///\n    /// Rules:\n    /// - `index <= n`; `index == n` appends.\n    /// - Existing blocks except the last must stay exactly `block_size` bytes.\n    /// - The last block may be any length 1..=block_size; changing its length\n    ///   changes the file length. Empty blocks are rejected.\n    pub fn put_block(&mut self, index: u64, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if index > self.n {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block index {index} beyond n={}\",\n                self.n\n            )));\n        }\n        if bytes.is_empty() || bytes.len() as u64 > self.block_size {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block length {} not in 1..={}\",\n                bytes.len(),\n                self.block_size\n            )));\n        }\n        if index < self.n && index + 1 < self.n && bytes.len() as u64 != self.block_size {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\n                \"only the last block may have a short length\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        let entry = JournalEntry {\n            op: OP_PUT,\n            index,\n            data: bytes.to_vec(),\n        };\n        // 1. Journal.\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&journal_path(&self.dir), &encode_journal(&[entry.clone()]))?;\n        // 2. Data file.\n        self.apply_put_to_data(&entry)?;\n        // 3. Incremental Merkle patch.\n        let new_leaf = leaf_hash(index as usize, bytes);\n        self.patch_merkle(index, new_leaf, self.n.max(index + 1))?;\n        // 4. Manifest + journal removal.\n        if index == self.n {\n            self.n += 1;\n        }\n        self.data_len = self.vfs.len(&data_path(&self.dir))?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Replace the entire payload atomically (journal-guarded full rebuild).\n    pub fn reset(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        let entries = if bytes.is_empty() {\n            Vec::new()\n        } else {\n            vec![JournalEntry {\n                op: OP_RESET,\n                index: 0,\n                data: bytes.to_vec(),\n            }]\n        };\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&journal_path(&self.dir), &encode_journal(&entries))?;\n        self.rebuild_from_bytes(bytes)?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Reread `data.bin` and rebuild every level file from scratch. Used on\n    /// journal recovery and by the full-rebuild comparison tests.\n    pub fn force_full_rebuild(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let bytes = self.vfs.read(&data_path(&self.dir))?;\n        self.rebuild_from_bytes(&bytes)?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn apply_put_to_data(&mut self, e: &JournalEntry) -> Result<()> {\n        let dp = data_path(&self.dir);\n        let start = e.index * self.block_size;\n        self.vfs.write_at(&dp, start, &e.data)?;\n        let new_end = start + e.data.len() as u64;\n        let cur_len = self.vfs.len(&dp)?;\n        if new_end < cur_len {\n            self.vfs.truncate(&dp, new_end)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Recompute one root-to-leaf path after leaf `idx` changed (appending\n    /// allowed; `new_n` is the leaf count including the appended leaf).\n    fn patch_merkle(&mut self, idx: u64, new_leaf: Hash32, new_n: u64) -> Result<()> {\n        let l0 = level_path(&self.dir, 0);\n        write_hash(&self.vfs, &l0, idx, &new_leaf)?;\n        self.vfs.sync(&l0)?;\n\n        let mut node = new_leaf;\n        let mut pos = idx;\n        let mut count = new_n;\n        let mut level = 0usize;\n        while count > 1 {\n            let path = level_path(&self.dir, level);\n            let parent_pos = pos / 2;\n            let parent = if pos % 2 == 0 {\n                // Even node: needs right sibling.\n                if pos + 1 < count {\n                    let right = read_hash(&self.vfs, &path, pos + 1)?;\n                    internal_hash(&node, &right)\n                } else {\n                    // Odd trailing node: promoted unchanged.\n                    node\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Odd node: needs left sibling.\n                let left = read_hash(&self.vfs, &path, pos - 1)?;\n                internal_hash(&left, &node)\n            };\n\n            level += 1;\n            let next_path = level_path(&self.dir, level);\n            write_hash(&self.vfs, &next_path, parent_pos, &parent)?;\n            self.vfs.sync(&next_path)?;\n\n            node = parent;\n            pos = parent_pos;\n            count = (count + 1) / 2;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn rebuild_from_bytes(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        // Validate block length: every chunk but the last must be full.\n        if !bytes.is_empty() && bytes.len() as u64 > self.n.saturating_add(0) * self.block_size {\n            // n here is the *old* count; reset may grow the file, so this check\n            // is only informational — chunks() below enforces shape by size.\n        }\n        let leaves: Vec<Hash32> = bytes\n            .chunks(self.block_size as usize)\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, c)| leaf_hash(i, c))\n            .collect();\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n\n        // data.bin\n        let dp = data_path(&self.dir);\n        self.vfs.write_atomic(&dp, bytes)?;\n\n        // Remove stale level files (possible shrink), then write current ones.\n        let mut lvl = 0usize;\n        loop {\n            let p = level_path(&self.dir, lvl);\n            if lvl < levels.len() {\n                let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(levels[lvl].len() * 32);\n                for h in &levels[lvl] {\n                    buf.extend_from_slice(h);\n                }\n                self.vfs.write_atomic(&p, &buf)?;\n            } else if self.vfs.exists(&p)? {\n                self.vfs.remove(&p)?;\n            } else {\n                break;\n            }\n            lvl += 1;\n        }\n\n        self.data_len = bytes.len() as u64;\n        self.n = leaves.len() as u64;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn commit_manifest_remove_journal(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let m = Manifest {\n            block_size: self.block_size,\n            data_len: self.data_len,\n            n: self.n,\n        };\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&manifest_path(&self.dir), &encode_manifest(&m))?;\n        let jp = journal_path(&self.dir);\n        if self.vfs.exists(&jp)? {\n            self.vfs.remove(&jp)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Replay an outstanding journal and fully rebuild.\n    fn recover(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let jp = journal_path(&self.dir);\n        let raw = self.vfs.read(&jp)?;\n        let entries = decode_journal(&raw)?;\n\n        if entries.iter().any(|e| e.op == OP_RESET) {\n            // Exactly one reset entry; ignore anything else.\n            let e = entries\n                .iter()\n                .find(|e| e.op == OP_RESET)\n                .expect(\"reset present\");\n            if e.data.len() as u64 > (u64::MAX / self.block_size) {\n                return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"journal payload absurd\".into()));\n            }\n            self.rebuild_from_bytes(&e.data)?;\n        } else {\n            for e in &entries {\n                self.apply_put_to_data(e)?;\n            }\n            let bytes = self.vfs.read(&data_path(&self.dir))?;\n            self.rebuild_from_bytes(&bytes)?;\n        }\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::vfs::{FaultyVfs, MemVfs, Op};\n\n    fn make(bytes: &[u8], bs: u64) -> Store<MemVfs> {\n        let mut s = Store::create(MemVfs::new(), Path::new(\"/repo\"), bs).unwrap();\n        s.reset(bytes).unwrap();\n        s\n    }\n\n    fn expected_root(bytes: &[u8], bs: u64) -> Hash32 {\n        let leaves: Vec<Hash32> = bytes\n            .chunks(bs as usize)\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, c)| leaf_hash(i, c))\n            .collect();\n        merkle::rebuild_root(&leaves)\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn manifest_roundtrip_and_validation() {\n        let m = Manifest { block_size: 4, data_len: 9, n: 3 };\n        assert_eq!(decode_manifest(&encode_manifest(&m)).unwrap(), m);\n        let mut bad = encode_manifest(&m);\n        bad[0] ^= 1;\n        assert!(decode_manifest(&bad).is_err());\n        assert!(decode_manifest(&encode_manifest(&Manifest {\n            block_size: 4,\n            data_len: 10,\n            n: 3\n        }))\n        .is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn incremental_puts_match_full_rebuild() {\n        for bs in 1u64..=5 {\n            let data: Vec<u8> = (0..20u8).collect();\n            let mut s = Store::create(MemVfs::new(), Path::new(\"/r\"), bs).unwrap();\n            let chunks: Vec<&[u8]> = data.chunks(bs as usize).collect();\n            for (i, c) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {\n                s.put_block(i as u64, c).unwrap();\n                let want = expected_root(&data[..((i as u64 * bs + c.len() as u64).min(data.len() as u64)) as usize], bs);\n                assert_eq!(s.root().unwrap(), want, \"append {i}, bs={bs}\");\n            }\n            // Overwrite a few blocks.\n            for i in [0usize, 3, chunks.len() - 1] File-backed chunked block store with per-level Merkle node files.\n//!\n//! ## On-disk format (all integers big-endian)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <repo>/\n//!   manifest           64 bytes (see below)\n//!   journal            present only while a write transaction is committed\n//!   data.bin           raw file bytes\n//!   level-0.bin        n  * 32 bytes — leaf hashes\n//!   level-1.bin        ⌈n/2⌉ * 32 bytes\n//!   ...                one file per tree level\n//! ```\n//!\n//! ### manifest (64 bytes)\n//! | offset | size | field       |\n//! |--------|------|-------------|\n//! | 0      | 16   | magic `MS-MANIFEST-V1\\0\\0` |\n//! | 16     | 8    | block_size (u64) |\n//! | 24     | 8    | data_len (u64) |\n//! | 32     | 8    | n (u64, leaf/block count) |\n//! | 40     | 24   | reserved, zero |\n//!\n//! A manifest is published only via temp-file + fsync + rename + dir fsync, so\n//! a 64-byte file is either the previous or the new manifest, never torn.\n//!\n//! ### journal\n//! | magic `MS-JOURNAL-V1\\0\\0\\0\\0` (16) |\n//! repeated entries:\n//! | op:u8 = 1 put / 2 reset | index:u64 | len:u64 | data(len) |\n//! For `reset` there is one leading entry carrying the whole new payload and\n//! n = ceil(len/block_size). `put` entries may append or overwrite one block.\n//!\n//! ## Sync boundary per mutating request\n//! 1. Journal written atomically (temp+fsync+rename+dir fsync).\n//! 2. `data.bin` patched (pwrite + fsync) — truncate when needed.\n//! 3. Affected Merkle levels patched incrementally (pwrite + fsync each).\n//! 4. New manifest published atomically; journal deleted; directory fsynced.\n//!\n//! Crash between 1 and 4 is repaired on next open by replaying the journal\n//! against `data.bin` and fully rebuilding every level file — always safe\n//! whether or not some level bytes had already been patched.\n\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse crate::merkle::{\n    self, build_levels, empty_root, internal_hash, leaf_hash, Hash32, RangeProof,\n};\nuse crate::vfs::Vfs;\n\nconst MANIFEST_MAGIC: &[u8; 16] = b\"MS-MANIFEST-V1\\0\\0\";\nconst JOURNAL_MAGIC: &[u8; 16] = b\"MS-JOURNAL-V1\\0\\0\\0\\0\";\nconst MANIFEST_LEN: usize = 64;\n\nconst OP_PUT: u8 = 1;\nconst OP_RESET: u8 = 2;\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    Io(io::Error),\n    Corrupt(String),\n    InvalidInput(String),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"io error: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::Corrupt(s) => write!(f, \"repository corrupt: {s}\"),\n            StoreError::InvalidInput(s) => write!(f, \"invalid request: {s}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\n\nimpl From<io::Error> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\ntype Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, StoreError>;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub block_size: u64,\n    pub data_len: u64,\n    pub n: u64,\n}\n\npub struct Store<V: Vfs> {\n    vfs: V,\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    block_size: u64,\n    data_len: u64,\n    n: u64,\n}\n\nfn data_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"data.bin\")\n}\nfn level_path(dir: &Path, level: usize) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(format!(\"level-{level}.bin\"))\n}\nfn manifest_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"manifest\")\n}\nfn journal_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"journal\")\n}\n\nfn encode_manifest(m: &Manifest) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut buf = vec![0u8; MANIFEST_LEN];\n    buf[0..16].copy_from_slice(MANIFEST_MAGIC);\n    buf[16..24].copy_from_slice(&m.block_size.to_be_bytes());\n    buf[24..32].copy_from_slice(&m.data_len.to_be_bytes());\n    buf[32..40].copy_from_slice(&m.n.to_be_bytes());\n    buf\n}\n\nfn decode_manifest(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Manifest> {\n    if buf.len() != MANIFEST_LEN || &buf[0..16] != MANIFEST_MAGIC {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"bad manifest magic/length\".into()));\n    }\n    let rd = |o: usize| -> u64 {\n        let mut b = [0u8; 8];\n        b.copy_from_slice(&buf[o..o + 8]);\n        u64::from_be_bytes(b)\n    };\n    let block_size = rd(16);\n    let data_len = rd(24);\n    let n = rd(32);\n    if block_size == 0 {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"block_size is zero\".into()));\n    }\n    if !buf[40..].iter().all(|&b| b == 0) {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"reserved manifest bytes non-zero\".into()));\n    }\n    let want_n = if data_len == 0 { 0 } else { (data_len - 1) / block_size + 1 };\n    if want_n != n {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(format!(\n            \"manifest n={n} inconsistent with data_len={data_len}, block_size={block_size}\"\n        )));\n    }\n    Ok(Manifest { block_size, data_len, n })\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct JournalEntry {\n    op: u8,\n    index: u64,\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn encode_journal(entries: &[JournalEntry]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::new();\n    buf.extend_from_slice(JOURNAL_MAGIC);\n    for e in entries {\n        buf.push(e.op);\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&e.index.to_be_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&(e.data.len() as u64).to_be_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&e.data);\n    }\n    buf\n}\n\nfn decode_journal(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<JournalEntry>> {\n    if buf.len() < 16 || &buf[0..16] != JOURNAL_MAGIC {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"bad journal magic\".into()));\n    }\n    let mut pos = 16;\n    let mut entries = Vec::new();\n    while pos < buf.len() {\n        if pos + 17 > buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"truncated journal header\".into()));\n        }\n        let op = buf[pos];\n        if op != OP_PUT && op != OP_RESET {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(format!(\"unknown journal op {op}\")));\n        }\n        let rd = |o: usize| -> u64 {\n            let mut b = [0u8; 8];\n            b.copy_from_slice(&buf[o..o + 8]);\n            u64::from_be_bytes(b)\n        };\n        let index = rd(pos + 1);\n        let len = rd(pos + 9) as usize;\n        pos += 17;\n        if pos + len > buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"truncated journal payload\".into()));\n        }\n        entries.push(JournalEntry {\n            op,\n            index,\n            data: buf[pos..pos + len].to_vec(),\n        });\n        pos += len;\n    }\n    Ok(entries)\n}\n\n// Level-file helpers ---------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn read_hash(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &Path, idx: u64) -> io::Result<Hash32> {\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 32];\n    let n = vfs.read_at(path, idx * 32, &mut buf)?;\n    if n != 32 {\n        return Err(io::Error::new(\n            io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n            \"level file short read\",\n        ));\n    }\n    Ok(buf)\n}\n\nfn write_hash(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &Path, idx: u64, h: &Hash32) -> io::Result<()> {\n    vfs.write_at(path, idx * 32, h)\n}\n\nimpl<V: Vfs> Store<V> {\n    // Open / create ----------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Open an existing repository, replaying an outstanding journal if any.\n    pub fn open(vfs: V, dir: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?; // harmless for MemVfs? — see below.\n        let mp = manifest_path(dir);\n        if !vfs.exists(&mp)? {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\n                \"no manifest in directory (use create first)\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let raw = vfs.read(&mp)?;\n        let m = decode_manifest(&raw)?;\n\n        let mut store = Store {\n            vfs,\n            dir: dir.to_path_buf(),\n            block_size: m.block_size,\n            data_len: m.data_len,\n            n: m.n,\n        };\n\n        let jp = journal_path(dir);\n        if store.vfs.exists(&jp)? {\n            store.recover()?;\n        }\n        Ok(store)\n    }\n\n    /// Create a fresh empty repository. Fails if one already exists.\n    pub fn create(vfs: V, dir: &Path, block_size: u64) -> Result<Self> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;\n        if block_size == 0 {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\"block_size must be > 0\".into()));\n        }\n        let mp = manifest_path(dir);\n        if vfs.exists(&mp)? {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\n                \"repository already exists\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let mut store = Store {\n            vfs,\n            dir: dir.to_path_buf(),\n            block_size,\n            data_len: 0,\n            n: 0,\n        };\n        store.vfs.write_atomic(&data_path(dir), &[])?;\n        store.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(store)\n    }\n\n    // Accessors --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    pub fn block_size(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.block_size\n    }\n    pub fn data_len(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.data_len\n    }\n    pub fn block_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.n\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> Result<Hash32> {\n        if self.n == 0 {\n            return Ok(empty_root());\n        }\n        let height = self.height();\n        read_hash(&self.vfs, &level_path(&self.dir, height), 0).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    /// Height = level index of the root.\n    fn height(&self) -> usize {\n        let n = self.n;\n        if n <= 1 {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        (63 - (n - 1).leading_zeros()) as usize + 1\n    }\n\n    pub fn read_block(&self, index: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        if index >= self.n {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block index {index} out of range (n={})\",\n                self.n\n            )));\n        }\n        let start = index * self.block_size;\n        let end = ((start + self.block_size).min(self.data_len)) as usize;\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; end - start as usize];\n        let got = self.vfs.read_at(&data_path(&self.dir), start, &mut buf)?;\n        if got != buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"data.bin short read\".into()));\n        }\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    pub fn read_data(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.vfs.read(&data_path(&self.dir)).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    pub fn manifest(&self) -> Manifest {\n        Manifest {\n            block_size: self.block_size,\n            data_len: self.data_len,\n            n: self.n,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn node(&self, level: usize, index: u64) -> Result<Hash32> {\n        read_hash(&self.vfs, &level_path(&self.dir, level), index).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    /// Build a range proof for blocks `[start,end)`, reading only the proof\n    /// nodes from disk — never the full data file.\n    pub fn prove_range(&self, start: u64, end: u64) -> Result<RangeProof> {\n        merkle::prove(self.n as usize, start as usize, end as usize, |lvl, idx| {\n            self.node(lvl, idx as u64).expect(\"node read\")\n        })\n        .map_err(|e| StoreError::InvalidInput(e.to_string()))\n    }\n\n    // Mutations --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Put (insert/overwrite) one block.\n    ///\n    /// Rules:\n    /// - `index <= n`; `index == n` appends.\n    /// - Existing blocks except the last must stay exactly `block_size` bytes.\n    /// - The last block may be any length 1..=block_size; changing its length\n    ///   changes the file length. Empty blocks are rejected.\n    pub fn put_block(&mut self, index: u64, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if index > self.n {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block index {index} beyond n={}\",\n                self.n\n            )));\n        }\n        if bytes.is_empty() || bytes.len() as u64 > self.block_size {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block length {} not in 1..={}\",\n                bytes.len(),\n                self.block_size\n            )));\n        }\n        if index < self.n && index + 1 < self.n && bytes.len() as u64 != self.block_size {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\n                \"only the last block may have a short length\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        let entry = JournalEntry {\n            op: OP_PUT,\n            index,\n            data: bytes.to_vec(),\n        };\n        // 1. Journal.\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&journal_path(&self.dir), &encode_journal(&[entry.clone()]))?;\n        // 2. Data file.\n        self.apply_put_to_data(&entry)?;\n        // 3. Incremental Merkle patch.\n        let new_leaf = leaf_hash(index as usize, bytes);\n        self.patch_merkle(index, new_leaf, self.n.max(index + 1))?;\n        // 4. Manifest + journal removal.\n        if index == self.n {\n            self.n += 1;\n        }\n        self.data_len = self.vfs.len(&data_path(&self.dir))?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Replace the entire payload atomically (journal-guarded full rebuild).\n    pub fn reset(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        let entries = if bytes.is_empty() {\n            Vec::new()\n        } else {\n            vec![JournalEntry {\n                op: OP_RESET,\n                index: 0,\n                data: bytes.to_vec(),\n            }]\n        };\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&journal_path(&self.dir), &encode_journal(&entries))?;\n        self.rebuild_from_bytes(bytes)?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Reread `data.bin` and rebuild every level file from scratch. Used on\n    /// journal recovery and by the full-rebuild comparison tests.\n    pub fn force_full_rebuild(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let bytes = self.vfs.read(&data_path(&self.dir))?;\n        self.rebuild_from_bytes(&bytes)?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn apply_put_to_data(&mut self, e: &JournalEntry) -> Result<()> {\n        let dp = data_path(&self.dir);\n        let start = e.index * self.block_size;\n        self.vfs.write_at(&dp, start, &e.data)?;\n        let new_end = start + e.data.len() as u64;\n        let cur_len = self.vfs.len(&dp)?;\n        if new_end < cur_len {\n            self.vfs.truncate(&dp, new_end)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Recompute one root-to-leaf path after leaf `idx` changed (appending\n    /// allowed; `new_n` is the leaf count including the appended leaf).\n    fn patch_merkle(&mut self, idx: u64, new_leaf: Hash32, new_n: u64) -> Result<()> {\n        let l0 = level_path(&self.dir, 0);\n        write_hash(&self.vfs, &l0, idx, &new_leaf)?;\n        self.vfs.sync(&l0)?;\n\n        let mut node = new_leaf;\n        let mut pos = idx;\n        let mut count = new_n;\n        let mut level = 0usize;\n        while count > 1 {\n            let path = level_path(&self.dir, level);\n            let parent_pos = pos / 2;\n            let parent = if pos % 2 == 0 {\n                // Even node: needs right sibling.\n                if pos + 1 < count {\n                    let right = read_hash(&self.vfs, &path, pos + 1)?;\n                    internal_hash(&node, &right)\n                } else {\n                    // Odd trailing node: promoted unchanged.\n                    node\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Odd node: needs left sibling.\n                let left = read_hash(&self.vfs, &path, pos - 1)?;\n                internal_hash(&left, &node)\n            };\n\n            level += 1;\n            let next_path = level_path(&self.dir, level);\n            write_hash(&self.vfs, &next_path, parent_pos, &parent)?;\n            self.vfs.sync(&next_path)?;\n\n            node = parent;\n            pos = parent_pos;\n            count = (count + 1) / 2;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn rebuild_from_bytes(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        // Validate block length: every chunk but the last must be full.\n        if !bytes.is_empty() && bytes.len() as u64 > self.n.saturating_add(0) * self.block_size {\n            // n here is the *old* count; reset may grow the file, so this check\n            // is only informational — chunks() below enforces shape by size.\n        }\n        let leaves: Vec<Hash32> = bytes\n            .chunks(self.block_size as usize)\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, c)| leaf_hash(i, c))\n            .collect();\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n\n        // data.bin\n        let dp = data_path(&self.dir);\n        self.vfs.write_atomic(&dp, bytes)?;\n\n        // Remove stale level files (possible shrink), then write current ones.\n        let mut lvl = 0usize;\n        loop {\n            let p = level_path(&self.dir, lvl);\n            if lvl < levels.len() {\n                let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(levels[lvl].len() * 32);\n                for h in &levels[lvl] {\n                    buf.extend_from_slice(h);\n                }\n                self.vfs.write_atomic(&p, &buf)?;\n            } else if self.vfs.exists(&p)? {\n                self.vfs.remove(&p)?;\n            } else {\n                break;\n            }\n            lvl += 1;\n        }\n\n        self.data_len = bytes.len() as u64;\n        self.n = leaves.len() as u64;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn commit_manifest_remove_journal(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let m = Manifest {\n            block_size: self.block_size,\n            data_len: self.data_len,\n            n: self.n,\n        };\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&manifest_path(&self.dir), &encode_manifest(&m))?;\n        let jp = journal_path(&self.dir);\n        if self.vfs.exists(&jp)? {\n            self.vfs.remove(&jp)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Replay an outstanding journal and fully rebuild.\n    fn recover(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let jp = journal_path(&self.dir);\n        let raw = self.vfs.read(&jp)?;\n        let entries = decode_journal(&raw)?;\n\n        if entries.iter().any(|e| e.op == OP_RESET) {\n            // Exactly one reset entry; ignore anything else.\n            let e = entries\n                .iter()\n                .find(|e| e.op == OP_RESET)\n                .expect(\"reset present\");\n            if e.data.len() as u64 > (u64::MAX / self.block_size) {\n                return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"journal payload absurd\".into()));\n            }\n            self.rebuild_from_bytes(&e.data)?;\n        } else {\n            for e in &entries {\n                self.apply_put_to_data(e)?;\n            }\n            let bytes = File-backed chunked block store with per-level Merkle node files.\n//!\n//! ## On-disk format (all integers big-endian)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <repo>/\n//!   manifest           64 bytes (see below)\n//!   journal            present only while a write transaction is committed\n//!   data.bin           raw file bytes\n//!   level-0.bin        n  * 32 bytes — leaf hashes\n//!   level-1.bin        ⌈n/2⌉ * 32 bytes\n//!   ...                one file per tree level\n//! ```\n//!\n//! ### manifest (64 bytes)\n//! | offset | size | field       |\n//! |--------|------|-------------|\n//! | 0      | 16   | magic `MS-MANIFEST-V1\\0\\0` |\n//! | 16     | 8    | block_size (u64) |\n//! | 24     | 8    | data_len (u64) |\n//! | 32     | 8    | n (u64, leaf/block count) |\n//! | 40     | 24   | reserved, zero |\n//!\n//! A manifest is published only via temp-file + fsync + rename + dir fsync, so\n//! a 64-byte file is either the previous or the new manifest, never torn.\n//!\n//! ### journal\n//! | magic `MS-JOURNAL-V1\\0\\0\\0\\0` (16) |\n//! repeated entries:\n//! | op:u8 = 1 put / 2 reset | index:u64 | len:u64 | data(len) |\n//! For `reset` there is one leading entry carrying the whole new payload and\n//! n = ceil(len/block_size). `put` entries may append or overwrite one block.\n//!\n//! ## Sync boundary per mutating request\n//! 1. Journal written atomically (temp+fsync+rename+dir fsync).\n//! 2. `data.bin` patched (pwrite + fsync) — truncate when needed.\n//! 3. Affected Merkle levels patched incrementally (pwrite + fsync each).\n//! 4. New manifest published atomically; journal deleted; directory fsynced.\n//!\n//! Crash between 1 and 4 is repaired on next open by replaying the journal\n//! against `data.bin` and fully rebuilding every level file — always safe\n//! whether or not some level bytes had already been patched.\n\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse crate::merkle::{\n    self, build_levels, empty_root, internal_hash, leaf_hash, Hash32, RangeProof,\n};\nuse crate::vfs::Vfs;\n\nconst MANIFEST_MAGIC: &[u8; 16] = b\"MS-MANIFEST-V1\\0\\0\";\nconst JOURNAL_MAGIC: &[u8; 16] = b\"MS-JOURNAL-V1\\0\\0\\0\\0\";\nconst MANIFEST_LEN: usize = 64;\n\nconst OP_PUT: u8 = 1;\nconst OP_RESET: u8 = 2;\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    Io(io::Error),\n    Corrupt(String),\n    InvalidInput(String),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"io error: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::Corrupt(s) => write!(f, \"repository corrupt: {s}\"),\n            StoreError::InvalidInput(s) => write!(f, \"invalid request: {s}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\n\nimpl From<io::Error> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\ntype Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, StoreError>;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub block_size: u64,\n    pub data_len: u64,\n    pub n: u64,\n}\n\npub struct Store<V: Vfs> {\n    vfs: V,\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    block_size: u64,\n    data_len: u64,\n    n: u64,\n}\n\nfn data_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"data.bin\")\n}\nfn level_path(dir: &Path, level: usize) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(format!(\"level-{level}.bin\"))\n}\nfn manifest_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"manifest\")\n}\nfn journal_path(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(\"journal\")\n}\n\nfn encode_manifest(m: &Manifest) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut buf = vec![0u8; MANIFEST_LEN];\n    buf[0..16].copy_from_slice(MANIFEST_MAGIC);\n    buf[16..24].copy_from_slice(&m.block_size.to_be_bytes());\n    buf[24..32].copy_from_slice(&m.data_len.to_be_bytes());\n    buf[32..40].copy_from_slice(&m.n.to_be_bytes());\n    buf\n}\n\nfn decode_manifest(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Manifest> {\n    if buf.len() != MANIFEST_LEN || &buf[0..16] != MANIFEST_MAGIC {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"bad manifest magic/length\".into()));\n    }\n    let rd = |o: usize| -> u64 {\n        let mut b = [0u8; 8];\n        b.copy_from_slice(&buf[o..o + 8]);\n        u64::from_be_bytes(b)\n    };\n    let block_size = rd(16);\n    let data_len = rd(24);\n    let n = rd(32);\n    if block_size == 0 {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"block_size is zero\".into()));\n    }\n    if !buf[40..].iter().all(|&b| b == 0) {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"reserved manifest bytes non-zero\".into()));\n    }\n    let want_n = if data_len == 0 { 0 } else { (data_len - 1) / block_size + 1 };\n    if want_n != n {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(format!(\n            \"manifest n={n} inconsistent with data_len={data_len}, block_size={block_size}\"\n        )));\n    }\n    Ok(Manifest { block_size, data_len, n })\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct JournalEntry {\n    op: u8,\n    index: u64,\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn encode_journal(entries: &[JournalEntry]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::new();\n    buf.extend_from_slice(JOURNAL_MAGIC);\n    for e in entries {\n        buf.push(e.op);\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&e.index.to_be_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&(e.data.len() as u64).to_be_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&e.data);\n    }\n    buf\n}\n\nfn decode_journal(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<JournalEntry>> {\n    if buf.len() < 16 || &buf[0..16] != JOURNAL_MAGIC {\n        return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"bad journal magic\".into()));\n    }\n    let mut pos = 16;\n    let mut entries = Vec::new();\n    while pos < buf.len() {\n        if pos + 17 > buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"truncated journal header\".into()));\n        }\n        let op = buf[pos];\n        if op != OP_PUT && op != OP_RESET {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(format!(\"unknown journal op {op}\")));\n        }\n        let rd = |o: usize| -> u64 {\n            let mut b = [0u8; 8];\n            b.copy_from_slice(&buf[o..o + 8]);\n            u64::from_be_bytes(b)\n        };\n        let index = rd(pos + 1);\n        let len = rd(pos + 9) as usize;\n        pos += 17;\n        if pos + len > buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"truncated journal payload\".into()));\n        }\n        entries.push(JournalEntry {\n            op,\n            index,\n            data: buf[pos..pos + len].to_vec(),\n        });\n        pos += len;\n    }\n    Ok(entries)\n}\n\n// Level-file helpers ---------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn read_hash(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &Path, idx: u64) -> io::Result<Hash32> {\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 32];\n    let n = vfs.read_at(path, idx * 32, &mut buf)?;\n    if n != 32 {\n        return Err(io::Error::new(\n            io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n            \"level file short read\",\n        ));\n    }\n    Ok(buf)\n}\n\nfn write_hash(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &Path, idx: u64, h: &Hash32) -> io::Result<()> {\n    vfs.write_at(path, idx * 32, h)\n}\n\nimpl<V: Vfs> Store<V> {\n    // Open / create ----------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Open an existing repository, replaying an outstanding journal if any.\n    pub fn open(vfs: V, dir: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?; // harmless for MemVfs? — see below.\n        let mp = manifest_path(dir);\n        if !vfs.exists(&mp)? {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\n                \"no manifest in directory (use create first)\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let raw = vfs.read(&mp)?;\n        let m = decode_manifest(&raw)?;\n\n        let mut store = Store {\n            vfs,\n            dir: dir.to_path_buf(),\n            block_size: m.block_size,\n            data_len: m.data_len,\n            n: m.n,\n        };\n\n        let jp = journal_path(dir);\n        if store.vfs.exists(&jp)? {\n            store.recover()?;\n        }\n        Ok(store)\n    }\n\n    /// Create a fresh empty repository. Fails if one already exists.\n    pub fn create(vfs: V, dir: &Path, block_size: u64) -> Result<Self> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;\n        if block_size == 0 {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\"block_size must be > 0\".into()));\n        }\n        let mp = manifest_path(dir);\n        if vfs.exists(&mp)? {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\n                \"repository already exists\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let mut store = Store {\n            vfs,\n            dir: dir.to_path_buf(),\n            block_size,\n            data_len: 0,\n            n: 0,\n        };\n        store.vfs.write_atomic(&data_path(dir), &[])?;\n        store.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(store)\n    }\n\n    // Accessors --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    pub fn block_size(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.block_size\n    }\n    pub fn data_len(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.data_len\n    }\n    pub fn block_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.n\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> Result<Hash32> {\n        if self.n == 0 {\n            return Ok(empty_root());\n        }\n        let height = self.height();\n        read_hash(&self.vfs, &level_path(&self.dir, height), 0).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    /// Height = level index of the root.\n    fn height(&self) -> usize {\n        let n = self.n;\n        if n <= 1 {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        (63 - (n - 1).leading_zeros()) as usize + 1\n    }\n\n    pub fn read_block(&self, index: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        if index >= self.n {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block index {index} out of range (n={})\",\n                self.n\n            )));\n        }\n        let start = index * self.block_size;\n        let end = ((start + self.block_size).min(self.data_len)) as usize;\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; end - start as usize];\n        let got = self.vfs.read_at(&data_path(&self.dir), start, &mut buf)?;\n        if got != buf.len() {\n            return Err(StoreError::Corrupt(\"data.bin short read\".into()));\n        }\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    pub fn read_data(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.vfs.read(&data_path(&self.dir)).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    pub fn manifest(&self) -> Manifest {\n        Manifest {\n            block_size: self.block_size,\n            data_len: self.data_len,\n            n: self.n,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn node(&self, level: usize, index: u64) -> Result<Hash32> {\n        read_hash(&self.vfs, &level_path(&self.dir, level), index).map_err(StoreError::Io)\n    }\n\n    /// Build a range proof for blocks `[start,end)`, reading only the proof\n    /// nodes from disk — never the full data file.\n    pub fn prove_range(&self, start: u64, end: u64) -> Result<RangeProof> {\n        merkle::prove(self.n as usize, start as usize, end as usize, |lvl, idx| {\n            self.node(lvl, idx as u64).expect(\"node read\")\n        })\n        .map_err(|e| StoreError::InvalidInput(e.to_string()))\n    }\n\n    // Mutations --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Put (insert/overwrite) one block.\n    ///\n    /// Rules:\n    /// - `index <= n`; `index == n` appends.\n    /// - Existing blocks except the last must stay exactly `block_size` bytes.\n    /// - The last block may be any length 1..=block_size; changing its length\n    ///   changes the file length. Empty blocks are rejected.\n    pub fn put_block(&mut self, index: u64, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if index > self.n {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block index {index} beyond n={}\",\n                self.n\n            )));\n        }\n        if bytes.is_empty() || bytes.len() as u64 > self.block_size {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(format!(\n                \"block length {} not in 1..={}\",\n                bytes.len(),\n                self.block_size\n            )));\n        }\n        if index < self.n && index + 1 < self.n && bytes.len() as u64 != self.block_size {\n            return Err(StoreError::InvalidInput(\n                \"only the last block may have a short length\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        let entry = JournalEntry {\n            op: OP_PUT,\n            index,\n            data: bytes.to_vec(),\n        };\n        // 1. Journal.\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&journal_path(&self.dir), &encode_journal(&[entry.clone()]))?;\n        // 2. Data file.\n        self.apply_put_to_data(&entry)?;\n        // 3. Incremental Merkle patch.\n        let new_leaf = leaf_hash(index as usize, bytes);\n        self.patch_merkle(index, new_leaf, self.n.max(index + 1))?;\n        // 4. Manifest + journal removal.\n        if index == self.n {\n            self.n += 1;\n        }\n        self.data_len = self.vfs.len(&data_path(&self.dir))?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Replace the entire payload atomically (journal-guarded full rebuild).\n    pub fn reset(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        let entries = if bytes.is_empty() {\n            Vec::new()\n        } else {\n            vec![JournalEntry {\n                op: OP_RESET,\n                index: 0,\n                data: bytes.to_vec(),\n            }]\n        };\n        self.vfs\n            .write_atomic(&journal_path(&self.dir), &encode_journal(&entries))?;\n        self.rebuild_from_bytes(bytes)?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Reread `data.bin` and rebuild every level file from scratch. Used on\n    /// journal recovery and by the full-rebuild comparison tests.\n    pub fn force_full_rebuild(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let bytes = self.vfs.read(&data_path(&self.dir))?;\n        self.rebuild_from_bytes(&bytes)?;\n        self.commit_manifest_remove_journal()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn apply_put_to_data(&mut self, e: &JournalEntry) -> Result<()> {\n        let dp = data_path(&self.dir);\n        let start = e.index * self.block_size;\n        self.vfs.write_at(&dp, start, &e.data)?;\n        let new_end = start + e.data.len() as u64;\n        let cur_len = self.vfs.len(&dp)?;\n        if new_end < cur_len {\n            self.vfs.truncate(&dp, new_end)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Recompute one root-to-leaf path after leaf `idx` changed (appending\n    /// allowed; `new_n` is the leaf count including the appended leaf).\n    fn patch_merkle(&mut self, idx: u64, new_leaf: Hash32, new_n: u64) -> Result<()> {\n        let l0 = level_path(&self.dir, 0);\n        write_hash(&self.vfs, &l0, idx, &new_leaf)?;\n        self.vfs.sync(&l0)?;\n\n        let mut node = new_leaf;\n        let mut pos = idx;\n        let mut count = new_n;\n        let mut level = 0usize;\n        while count > 1 {\n            let path = level_path(&self.dir, level);\n            let parent_pos = pos / 2;\n            let parent = if pos % 2 == 0 {\n                // Even node: needs right sibling.\n                if pos + 1 < count {\n                    let right = read_hash(&self.vfs, &path, pos + 1)?;\n                    internal_hash(&node, &right)\n                } else {\n                    // Odd trailing node: promoted unchanged.\n                    node\n                }\n            } else {\n {"parentUuid":"355936f8-a726-4f05-9a53-7de4a4bb63ac","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_gz13uuio5lsunogzkytmtqoa","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/a/src/http.rs","content":"//! Minimal dependency-free HTTP/1.1 layer.\n//!\n//! One request per connection (`Connection: close`), bounded request body,\n//! simple path/query routing. No third-party runtime — each accepted\n//! connection is served on its own OS thread.\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\npub const MAX_BODY: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct Request {\n    pub method: String,\n    pub path: String, // path component, no query\n    pub query: String, // raw query string after '?'\n    pub body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nimpl Request {\n    pub fn query_param<'a>(&'a self, name: &str) -> Option<String> {\n        for pair in
